name: Chinese HSK (汉字)
description: HSK 3.0 vocabulary learning card. Shows simplified Chinese word (large), with pinyin / part-of-speech / traditional (when different) / HSK level combined on one meta row. Below: English definition in a tinted panel, with a small English-only 'Source:' credit (separate field, e.g. CC-CEDICT) at the panel's bottom-right. Pronunciation reads the CHINESE CHARACTERS via zh voice, never pinyin. Actions: 发音 / 标记 / 收藏. Top-right buttons consistent with other templates.
